'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]]. This clue is only given out if the player has completed [[Priest in Peril]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1747242619317477421|date=16 January 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963982|archivedate=5 May 2026|quote=I think it's gated behind Priest in Peril. Which is uncommon behaviour for clues, but that one seems to be an exception.}}
